tagline: Continuous dryer for viscous, heat-sensitive and fouling materials. A rotating blade assembly spreads the feed into a thin, turbulent film on the heated wall, enabling rapid evaporation under vacuum, ideal for ZLD, effluent salts and high-value products.

overview.p0: The Gausin Agitated Thin Film Dryer (ATFD) is a vertical, jacketed cylinder fitted with a rotor carrying hinged or fixed blades. The rotor spreads incoming feed into a thin, highly turbulent film over the heated wall, achieving fast evaporation even for difficult products.
overview.p1: Because the film is constantly wiped and renewed, the ATFD handles viscous, fouling, foaming and heat-sensitive feeds that would scale or burn in conventional dryers. Operation under vacuum lowers the boiling point and protects product quality.
overview.p2: ATFDs are a key element of Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) plants, converting evaporator concentrate into a dry, handleable powder or flakes. Gausin supplies them in SS 304 / 316L with optional crystallizing and condensing systems.

how.0.title: Feed Entry
how.0.desc: Concentrated feed is metered into the top of the heated cylinder.
how.1.title: Film Formation
how.1.desc: Rotor blades spread the feed into a thin, turbulent film on the wall.
how.2.title: Evaporation
how.2.desc: Heat from the jacket evaporates moisture / solvent from the moving film.
how.3.title: Vapour Removal
how.3.desc: Vapour is drawn off under vacuum to a condenser for recovery.
how.4.title: Drying to Solid
how.4.desc: As the film travels down, it dries into powder, flakes or cake.
how.5.title: Discharge
how.5.desc: Dry solid is discharged via a screw or rotary valve at the base.
